result.rationale: In the save action, props.category_id is captured from this.get('categoryId') at save time, but the success handler later calls host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))) — re-reading categoryId at resolution time. The category-chooser input is not disabled while host.isSaving (only the save/cancel d-buttons are), so a user can change the selection during the pending request, causing the displayed category to differ from what the server persisted. Mechanism is directly verifiable in the diff lines of embeddable-host.js.es6.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the save action in embeddable-host.js.es6 lines 29-38: The code captures `this.get('categoryId')` at line 33 before the async save, then in the success callback at line 36 it uses `this.get('categoryId')` again. If the user changes the category selection while the save is in flight, the callback will use the new categoryId value rather than the one that was actually sent to the server. This is a race condition where the UI could display a category that wasn't actually persisted.
